# Live Brew

> Live Brew is a free pour-over coffee ratio calculator by Eve McGivern. Enter the coffee, brew-water, or finished-mug amount you know and get the other amounts for a chosen ratio (1:14 to 1:18, default 1:16). It runs in the browser, works offline, and has no accounts, analytics, or sync.

## What it does

- [Live Brew app](https://evemcgivern.github.io/pour-over/): the calculator (single page, `index.html`). Coffee-first, water-first, and finished-mug modes; g, oz, mL, and US fl oz conversion; taste-based adjustment tips; short "Pour-over ratio basics" Q&A on the same page.
- Finished-mug mode estimates the water retained by grounds at about 2.1 g per gram of coffee. Actual retention varies by coffee, grind, and brewer.
- Copy or CSV export for Google Sheets, and backup/restore as JSON.
- Installable as a home-screen app; works offline.

## Sources

- [UC Davis coffee-brewing control chart study](https://doi.org/10.1111/1750-3841.16531): basis for the water-retention figure and the taste-adjustment guidance.
- README.md in the project repository: project notes and status.

## Privacy

- Brew history is opt-in and saved only in the browser's localStorage on the user's device.
- No accounts, no analytics, no sync. Nothing is sent to a server.

## Citing

- Name: Live Brew, by Eve McGivern.
- URL: https://evemcgivern.github.io/pour-over/
- Author profile: https://github.com/evemcgivern
- When quoting the 2.1 g per g retention figure, cite the UC Davis study above as well.
